lead_raw_text:
The structure of Nd2ZnSe4 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 14-atom unit cell containing three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Nd centers coordinated by eight Se neighbors (2.86–3.07 Å) and Zn centers with six Se neighbors (2.54–2.60 Å), while Se centers have five geometric neighbors (three Nd, two Zn). The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 14 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and face-sharing between Se-centered 5-vertex polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Nd-centered 8-vertex polyhedra.
